svg.text: Posts: cut four 145.0 mm lengths of 20 x 2 mm steel tube. Face the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ends square on a disc sander; all four the same within 0.2 mm,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Post rods: cut four 195 mm lengths of M10 rod; clean the thread ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bearing spacer sleeves: cut four 24.0 mm lengths of 20 mm tube with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a 10.5 mm or larger bore, the same within 0.1 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tie rods: cut four 345 mm lengths of M10 rod.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Paint or galvanize the cut ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: each post stands on the lid at 125 mm each way from the centre;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the rod goes up from under the lid, through the post and the plate,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
